serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Lexis+® for Government is a legal research solution built specifically for attorneys and legal professionals at government agencies.   The platform delivers a comprehensive research experience, including primary law, secondary sources, Shepard’s® citation validation, and document upload and review capabilities.   Attorneys can save, annotate, share and collaborate on research documents and searches with colleagues and stakeholders, while maintaining the highest levels of security and compliance required for sensitive legal matters.    Lexis+ for Government allows federal government attorneys to work more productively and effectively, freeing up more time for high-value work.
